thread:
Maya R.: Heads-up — ACME escalated: promo codes not granting free-trial credits. They tried ~150 redemptions yesterday, ~40 failed. Ticket: https://zendesk.company/tickets/5678. @carlos @priya can we triage?

Carlos G.: Thanks — pulling ticket. Can you paste a failing promo code + sample API request/response?

Maya R.: Sample code: ACME-TRIAL-2026. Repro curl I ran:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/promos/apply -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx' -d '{"customer_id":"acct_0432","code":"ACME-TRIAL-2026"}'
```
Response: 422 Unprocessable Entity
```
{"error":"invalid_redemption_limit","message":"redemptions_per_account must be >=1 or null"}
```

Priya N.: Looking in the admin import logs — the ACME row was imported from the partner CSV on 2026-03-02. The CSV cell for per_account_redemptions is the literal string "0" (not empty). Also redeem_start and redeem_end were provided in local timezone without Z -> stored such that end < start in UTC for some rows. Snippet from CSV row: `ACME,ACME-TRIAL-2026,trial,30,"0","2026-03-02T00:00","2026-03-02T00:00"`

Ashok L.: That explains the 422. Our promo validation treats "0" -> int 0 and then blocks because >=1 required (0 means zero redemptions). Two separate issues: CSV importer didn't coerce string values correctly; timezone parsing dropped zone info. Short-term we can patch DB for affected promos. Longer-term: tighten importer validation and add schema docs.

Maya R.: Repro steps I followed locally: 1) create promo via Admin > Import CSV (used same CSV) 2) try applying code via POST /v1/promos/apply -> 422 as above. When I manually updated per_account_redemptions=null and normalized times to ISO Z, apply succeeded and credits were issued.

Priya N.: I'll run a SQL check for promos where per_account_redemptions IN ('0', '"0"') OR (redeem_end <= redeem_start) and produce a list. We should backfill and retro-credit impacted accounts.

Ashok L.: I'll push a quick patch to the importer to coerce the following: string '0' -> NULL (we treat NULL as unlimited), 'unlimited' -> NULL, and to require timezone-aware ISO (append Z if missing). Rolling to staging now, aiming prod deploy in ~40m. Also preparing a one-off DB migration script to update rows found by Priya.

Carlos G.: Manual fix executed for ACME row — updated per_account_redemptions to NULL and adjusted timestamps. Customer confirmed credits were granted. Notifying ACME now. Action items: 1) prod importer patch & tests 2) run backfill script for affected promos 3) add CSV schema validation + docs for partners 4) notify finance if any billing adjustments for retro credits :white_check_mark:

Maya R.: Thanks everyone. I'll file a postmortem and send a customer update. Leaving this thread open until patch is live and backfill completes. :thumbsup:
